blb.text: Gev stumbles on the nameless, mute badgerfolk Hugs on an adventure, and after Hugs fends off a Calamity Beast while Gev leads a town to safety, Gev names him for the hugs the children give him.
When Hugs volunteers to accompany Mabel to Pondside, Gev begrudgingly joins the party to keep an eye on him, and on the road he tells a tall tale that Mabel says is his way of coping.
The party fights necromancers' skeletons, and when the Flood Gar attacks the Docklands, a great wave sweeps them into the Long River, where Hugs keeps everyone afloat.
They reach Fountainport and battle the Direshades in the throne room, and the returning heroes are welcomed home with a parade in Goodhill.
